elements.title: World Mine Production and Reserves
elements.content:
| Mine production8, 9 | 2022 | 2023e |
|---------------------|------|-------|
| United States       | 175  | 190   |
| Brazil              | e40  | 40    |
| China               | e70  | 74    |
| Madagascar          | e1   | 1     |
| Mozambique          | 25   | 24    |
| Rwanda              | e1   | 1     |
| Uganda              | e1   | 1     |
| World total (rounded) | 313  | 330   |
elements.notes:
8In addition to the countries listed, Kazakhstan and Portugal may have produced beryl ore, but available information was inadequate to make reliable estimates of output. Other nations that produced gemstone beryl ore may also have produced some industrial beryl ore.
9Based on 4% beryllium content of bertrandite and beryl sources.
10See Appendix C for resource and reserve definitions and information concerning data sources.
